title: Unified xswap Superset Chain: Batch Swap-In, Order-4 mTHP Reassembly, and 2-Level RCU Radix Reclaim
headline: A three-stage compounding kernel chain evolved upstream xswap across synchronous zswap batching (M1), 64KB mTHP fault reassembly (M2), and 2-level RCU radix hole reclamation (M3), achieving -63.1% fragmented metadata overhead across all 17 correctness gates.
patches_lead: Key kernel hunks across the three-stage compounding commit chain (5e84ca92 -> 5cde9eaa -> 53e02e86 -> 2c1ddb53).

patches.takeaway: Milestone 1 (5cde9eaa28a2): Synchronous zswap batch swap-in loader in mm/xswap.c and mm/swap_state.c
Milestone 2 (53e02e8615a3): Speculative order-4 (64KB) mTHP swap-in reassembly in mm/xswap.c and mm/swap_state.c
Milestone 3 (2c1ddb537fd9): 2-level RCU radix cluster directory and lockless kfree_rcu() hole reclaim in include/linux/swap.h and mm/swapfile.c

sections.title: Why this experiment
sections.lead: Upstream xswap stops at dynamic VM_SPARSE high-water-mark growth and single-page synchronous swap-in, leaving three structural gaps along the swap lifecycle.

blocks.takeaway: Three compounding milestones upgrade swap-in batching, 64KB mTHP reassembly, and interior metadata hole reclamation

blocks.text: Each candidate commits directly atop the previous milestone tree, forming a verified 3-stage lineage.

sections.title: Where the cost appears
sections.lead: Single-page faults repeat radix lookups, split 64KB folios stay fragmented as 4KB pages, and high-offset pinned slots block tail-only VM_SPARSE shrink.

blocks.takeaway: Three bottlenecks limit upstream xswap across swap-in and fragmented swap-out lifetimes

blocks.text: In upstream xswap, a single live high-offset slot pins every interior swap_cluster_info page below the high-water mark.

sections.title: The affected path
sections.lead: The compounding chain spans do_swap_page(), swapin_sync(), xswap.c zswap helpers, and swapfile.c cluster directory management.

blocks.takeaway: End-to-end swap path across M1 batching, M2 mTHP reassembly, and M3 RCU chunk reclaim

blocks.text: swap_cluster_lookup_rcu() re-verifies si->cluster_dir[chunk_idx] == chunk after acquiring ci->lock to close races against concurrent chunk unlinking.

sections.title: What actually changed
sections.lead: M1 adds batched zswap prefetching, M2 reassembles 16 contiguous slots into an order-4 folio, and M3 replaces flat VM_SPARSE arrays with 64-cluster RCU chunks.

blocks.takeaway: Two-level RCU radix directory frees empty 64-cluster interior chunks without synchronize_rcu() stalls

blocks.text: When any slot in a 64KB block fails exclusive count==1 validation, M2 falls back cleanly to M1 order-0 swap-in without partial state leakage.

sections.title: The next decision
sections.lead: All three compounding patches pass independent correctness review and all 17 correctness gates across 209 QEMU guest runs, ready for bare-metal NVMe validation.

blocks.takeaway: Promote the unified 3-patch series (2c1ddb537fd9) to bare-metal validation

blocks.text: In fragmented swap workloads, M3 cuts metadata consumption from 0.301 B/slot (upstream baseline) to 0.111 B/slot (-63.1%).
